name: Fallarbor Town
lines:
What’s up, what’s up?
I saw some shady fellows scuttling in
and out of Professor Cozmo’s lab.

This region’s been known for meteors
since the olden days.
They say Meteor Falls was gouged out
by a falling meteoroid long ago.

See! Take a look!
This is my precious Marill!
It’s slick and smooth and plushy!
If you, too, have a Marill with you,
you can pet its slick and smooth and
plushy fur as much as you want!

Have you already challenged Flannery,
the Leader of Lavaridge Gym?
The girl’s grandfather was famous.
He was one of the Elite Four in the
Pokémon League at one point.
It wouldn’t surprise me to see Flannery
become a great Trainer in her own right.

Pokémon Contest Spectacular!
Registrations accepted inside.
Have a blast, Pokémon!
Go for broke, Trainers!

Fallarbor Town
A farm community with small gardens.

Move Maniac’s House
Let me teach moves to Pokémon.
